content_sections.heading: About WBPDCL
content_sections.text: The West Bengal Power Development Corporation Limited is a Government of West Bengal Enterprise engaged in the business of generation of electricity in the State of West Bengal. Its Registered & Corporate Office is at 'Bidyut Unnayan Bhaban', Plot No. 3/C, LA-Block, Sector III, Bidhannagar, Kolkata – 700106. The notice was issued by the Recruitment Cell, WBPDCL, and published on 23 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Important Dates
content_sections.text: As of 23 November 2026, the online application window has not yet opened; it opens on 25 November 2026 at 12:00 hrs.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details (Post-wise)
content_sections.text: WBPDCL has notified a total of 2 vacancies, one for each Executive Director post, both in the Unreserved (UR) category.

rows.post: Executive Director (Finance & Accounts and Regulatory Affairs)

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Each post has its own minimum essential qualification and experience, as printed in the notice. Qualification: Graduate in Engineering (Electrical / Mechanical / Instrumentation / Instrumentation & Control Engg. / Electrical & Electronics / Electronics / Electronics & Telecommunication / Electronics & Instrumentation / Power Plant Engineering) from any recognized University or reputed Institute approved by AICTE. Experience: 20 years (post qualification) or more in a large Power Generation Company in a professional environment. Out of this, minimum 2 (two) years' experience as Station-in-Charge/ General Manager in any Thermal Power Station. Qualification: Graduate in any discipline with membership of the Institute of Chartered / Cost Accountants of India (ACA / ACMA). Experience: 20 years (post qualification) or more in senior position in Finance & Accounts Department in a large Engineering Industry / Power Utility/ Manufacturing Industry in a professional environment. Out of this, minimum two (2) years' experience in the rank of General Manager or equivalent with experience in Project Financing, Taxation, Finance & Accounts, Budgeting and in Regulatory Affairs in Public Sector Power Utilities. Further, Officers of State / Central Govt. having the required qualification with working experience of 20 years or more as well as experience of at least 3 years in any Central / State PSU in the relevant field are also eligible. Ability to read, write and speak in Bengali is an essential requirement for both posts, but such knowledge is not mandatory for candidates whose mother tongue is Nepali, unless specifically mentioned. This ability will be tested at the Personal Interview, and candidature of candidates with average or poor performance in the knowledge of Bengali/ Nepali shall be liable to be cancelled. All qualification certificates should be issued by a recognized Board / Institute / University only. Where a Grade Point System is adopted, the CGPA will be converted into equivalent marks in line with the AICTE methodology: The minimum age limit for both posts is 52 years and the maximum age limit is 58 years as on 01.11.2026. The upper age limit shall be relaxed up to 59 years (as on 01.11.2026) for the Departmental candidates of WBPDCL. Date of Birth will be taken as that mentioned in the birth certificate issued by the Competent Authority/ Certificate or Admit card of Class X or equivalent examination; no other proof of date of birth shall be accepted. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Both Executive Director posts carry a Basic Pay of Rs. 1,56,500/- in the Pay Scale of Rs. 1,56,500 – 2,10,800/-, Pay Level 14 of WBPDCL ROPA – 2020. Along with the basic pay, the following shall be made admissible as per Rules of the Corporation: Dearness Allowance HRA Medical Allowance and benefits of medical treatment for self & dependents Electricity Allowance LTC/ HTC Contributory Provident Fund, Gratuity and Leave encashment, along with other applicable allowances The notice does not mention a contract term, probation or place of posting; the Personal Interview will be held in Kolkata.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for WBPDCL Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications are accepted only online through the 'APPLY ONLINE' link on the WBPDCL recruitment portal ( www.wbpdcl.co.in ). No other mode of application, and no manual/ physical application, will be accepted. WBPDCL departmental candidates must also apply online. Keep ready a valid E-mail ID, Mobile number, Aadhaar Number and a scanned copy of a recent passport size coloured photograph. Open the online application form in the 'Career Section' at www.wbpdcl.co.in between 25.11.2026 (12:00 hrs) and 16.12.2026 (12:00 hrs). Enter your name as it appears in the educational certificate of Secondary or equivalent examination. Upload a clear and recognizable recent photograph; an unclear photograph makes the application liable to be rejected. Keep enough copies of the same photograph for later stages. Select your Reservation Category (UR/ SC/ ST/ OBC/ EWS) carefully, as it cannot be changed later. Submit the application and download the system generated Application Slip; it must be submitted at the Personal Interview, if called for. Incomplete applications, or applications not fulfilling any eligibility criteria, will be rejected summarily. Requests to change mailing address/ category/ discipline/ qualification once declared will not be entertained. The printout of the Application Slip must not be tampered with; overwriting or tampering will lead to rejection. Proof of Date of Birth (birth certificate issued by the Competent Authority, or Certificate/ Admit card of Class X or equivalent) Proof of Qualification and Category Application Slip Legally accepted documentary proof of change of name, if any NOC (No Objection Certificate) from the present employer, for applicants working in Government/ Semi-Government/ PSU(s)/ Autonomous bodies These documents are to be furnished at the time of the Personal Interview by shortlisted candidates, as per the intimation given to them.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection for both Executive Director posts is by Personal Interview only, to be held in Kolkata. Only shortlisted candidates shall be called, and credentials will be verified before the interview; any non-conformity with the qualification will lead to summary rejection. The Final Merit List of eligible candidates will be prepared on the scores obtained in the Personal Interview. Bengali language ability (or Nepali, for those whose mother tongue is Nepali) will be tested at the interview. If more than one candidate scores equal percentage of marks, the date of birth in chronological order (seniority wise) decides who is placed higher in the merit panel. The list of shortlisted candidates will be displayed on the WBPDCL website and intimated by e-mail. No physical interview call letters will be issued; candidates must download and print their own call letters.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in WBPDCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: one Executive Director (Operation Service) and one Executive Director (Finance & Accounts and Regulatory Affairs), both UR.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the WBPDCL Executive Director posts?
faq.answer: The online application closes on 16 December 2026 at 12:00 hrs. It opens on 25 November 2026 at 12:00 hrs.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for Executive Director (Operation Service)?
faq.answer: A Graduate in Engineering (Electrical / Mechanical / Instrumentation / related listed disciplines) from a recognized University or AICTE-approved Institute, with 20 years of post-qualification experience, including at least 2 years as Station-in-Charge/ General Manager in a Thermal Power Station.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for Executive Director (Finance & Accounts and Regulatory Affairs)?
faq.answer: A Graduate in any discipline with ACA / ACMA membership, with 20 years of post-qualification experience including at least two years at General Manager rank or equivalent. Officers of State / Central Govt. with 20 years' experience and at least 3 years in a Central / State PSU in the relevant field are also eligible.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for WBPDCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 52 years and the maximum is 58 years as on 01.11.2026. WBPDCL departmental candidates get relaxation up to 59 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of a WBPDCL Executive Director?
faq.answer: Basic Pay is Rs. 1,56,500/- in the Pay Scale of Rs. 1,56,500 – 2,10,800/-, Pay Level 14 of WBPDCL ROPA – 2020, with DA, HRA, Medical and Electricity Allowance and other benefits as per Corporation rules.

faq.question: Q7. How to apply for WBPDCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online only through the 'APPLY ONLINE' link in the Career Section of www.wbpdcl.co.in; no physical application is accepted, and departmental candidates must also apply online.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the WBPDCL Executive Director posts?
faq.answer: Selection is by Personal Interview only, held in Kolkata, carrying 100 marks and 100% weightage. Only shortlisted candidates are called.

faq.question: Q9. Is knowledge of Bengali required?
faq.answer: Yes, ability to read, write and speak Bengali is essential, except for candidates whose mother tongue is Nepali. It will be tested at the Personal Interview.

faq.question: Q10. Do government or PSU employees need an NOC?
faq.answer: Yes. Applicants working in Government/ Semi-Government/ PSU(s)/ Autonomous bodies must produce an NOC from their present employer at the interview, failing which they will not be allowed for interview.
